SAP Fieldglass Worker Profile Management

By tracking all nonemployees in one place, you can efficiently manage and gain visibility into your entire workforce.
Request a demo

A simpler way to track all your nontraditional external workers

You can strengthen compliance and mitigate risk while optimizing results by increasing visibility and control across your entire population of nonpayroll workers – even those not tied to a job posting or statement of work in your vendor management system.

View and maintain a single, standardized record of your external workers, including contact information, work history, security IDs, certifications, training, and asset access, with the SAP Fieldglass Worker Profile Management application.

  • Cloud deployment
  • Centralized access to worker data to manage headcount and compliance
  • Automation of onboarding and offboarding tasks
  • Retrieval of company assets upon completion of the work
Read the data sheet

Key benefits

Strengthen business security

Centrally manage external worker access and offboarding to reduce risk and ensure timely asset retrieval.

Improve visibility into external worker information

Track licenses and certifications, enable suppliers to maintain accurate worker details, and use a “do not rehire” flag to help prevent rehiring ineligible workers.

Key features

Single source of truth for external worker data

  • Centralize worker profiles in one application.
  • Manage worker information with role-based permissions.
  • Track project status and receive notices for outstanding tasks.
  • Examine worker categories with analytics.
  • Upload worker profiles in bulk.

 

Standardized data record and profile

  • Maintain consistent, standardized data records for all external workers, including those who don’t submit time sheets or expense sheets.
  • Assign a master worker ID and security IDs that follow each worker to enforce rehire eligibility decisions across managers and divisions.

Automated onboarding and offboarding

  • Automate and track onboarding tasks, such as background checks and security training.
  • Manage facility, system, and data access for external workers, and track equipment throughout the worker lifecycle.
  • Set configurable alerts for worker events, so onboarding and offboarding tasks happen on time.

Frequently asked questions

SAP Fieldglass Worker Profile Management is a cloud application that gives you one standardized record for every nonpayroll external worker, even those not tied to a job posting or statement of work. Manage contact details, work history, security IDs, certifications, training, and asset access in a single place.

 

Learn more about SAP external workforce management.

SAP Fieldglass Worker Profile Management and SAP Fieldglass Contingent Workforce Management serve different workers. SAP Fieldglass Contingent Workforce Management handles workers tied to a job posting or statement of work in your vendor management system. SAP Fieldglass Worker Profile Management covers the nontraditional external workers who fall outside that scope, helping ensure all external workers are tracked and managed.

SAP Fieldglass Worker Profile Management helps you see and manage who has access to your facilities and systems. You assign security IDs, track licenses and mandatory training, and automate offboarding so access is closed and company assets are retrieved when work ends.

 

Learn more about SAP data security.

No, SAP Fieldglass Worker Profile Management runs as a standalone cloud application with no prerequisite. It integrates with both on-premises and cloud systems.

Suppliers and administrators can record each worker's licenses and certifications on their profile. You can schedule mandatory training during onboarding and monitor progress toward completion. This gives you a clear, current view of who is qualified and compliant across your external workforce.

 

Learn more about SAP compliance.
